name: Palmer Archipelago Penguins
tagline: Classify Antarctic penguin species with mixed types, missingness, and Simpson's paradox.
description:
Collected between 2007 and 2009 by Dr. Kristen Gorman and the Palmer Station Long Term Ecological Research (LTER) program in Antarctica, and curated by Allison Horst, Alison Hill, and Kristen Gorman (2020), Palmer Penguins is the modern open-licensed ecological benchmark designed to complement or replace Iris.

Unlike Iris, Palmer Penguins introduces realistic tabular complexities ideal for early learners: moderate class imbalance across three Pygoscelis species (Adelie, Gentoo, Chinstrap), mixed continuous and categorical predictors (island, sex, study year), 19 explicit missing values across 11 incomplete rows, and a textbook manifestation of Simpson's paradox where overall negative correlation between bill length and bill depth reverses to positive within each species.

targetCandidates.description: Predict penguin species (Adelie, Chinstrap, or Gentoo) from bill dimensions, flipper length, body mass, island, and sex.
Predict biological sex ('female' vs. 'male') to explore ecological sexual dimorphism within penguin species.
Predict nesting island (Biscoe, Dream, or Torgersen) in the Palmer Archipelago.

columns.name: species
columns.description: Pygoscelis penguin species observed nesting in the Palmer Archipelago.

columns.name: island
columns.description: Island in the Palmer Archipelago, Antarctica where the penguin was measured (note: Gentoo was sampled only on Biscoe and Chinstrap only on Dream).

columns.name: bill_length_mm
columns.description: Length of the dorsal ridge of the penguin's upper bill (culmen).

columns.name: bill_depth_mm
columns.description: Vertical thickness (depth) of the penguin's bill; exhibits Simpson's paradox when plotted against bill length without species conditioning.

columns.name: flipper_length_mm
columns.description: Length of the penguin's flipper wing measured with a ruler.

columns.name: body_mass_g
columns.description: Total body mass in grams; differs in numeric scale by two orders of magnitude from bill dimensions, illustrating feature scaling effects.

columns.name: sex
columns.description: Biological sex determined via molecular or morphometric field protocols (missing for 11 specimens).

columns.name: year
columns.description: Calendar year in which the field observation season began (2007, 2008, or 2009).

warnings: Ecological wildlife data with no human subjects; field handling of Antarctic wildlife followed US Antarctic Program and LTER animal welfare permits.

Because island strongly co-varies with species in this three-island sample (Gentoo only on Biscoe, Chinstrap only on Dream), learners should inspect whether tree models rely on geographic shortcuts rather than morphology.
